blocks.text: You can create a custom dashboard according to your organization's requirements in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). These dashboards provide the flexibility to add and customize various widgets as required. You must add at least one widget to configure a new custom dashboard. You can also use predefined dashboard templates to create a custom dashboard. To learn more, see Using Dashboard Templates.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Explore.
In the left-side navigation, click Dashboards.
See image.
Click New.
The Create New Dashboard window appears.
In the Create New Dashboard window:
Name: Enter a name for the dashboard.
Description: (Optional) Enter a description for the dashboard.
Viewers: Select the users who can view the dashboard.
Public: Select to grant view access to all users in the account.
Specific Users: Select specific users that can view the dashboard.
To keep the dashboard private, leave the Viewers drop-down menu blank.
Editors: Select the users who can edit the dashboard.
Public: Select to grant edit access to all users in the account.
Specific Users: Select specific users that can edit the dashboard. The edit access overrides the view access.
To keep the dashboard private, leave the Editors drop-down menu blank.
Pin to Apps: (Optional) Select the application that you want to pin to the dashboard.
Tags: Enter a tag name, or select from existing tags. You can add one or more tags to a dashboard to categorize it.
See image.
You can also click Import Template to upload a dashboard template.
Click Create.
The Create New Widget page appears.

blocks.text: After creating the dashboard, you can add widgets to it by selecting the required dimensions and measurements. The dimension defines how data is grouped in a widget (e.g., by user, tenant, or severity, etc.) and the measurement defines the value to be calculated and displayed in the widget (e.g., count of alerts, number of users, or risk score, etc.).
To add widgets to the dashboard:

blocks.item: In the Create New Widget window:
Select a widget type in the left-side pane (e.g., Bar, Line, Pie).
The widget type affects the number of measurements and dimensions you can add to the widget. To learn more, see Understanding Dashboard Widget Types.
In the right pane, replace Widget Title (Optional) with a custom title.
See image.
Customize the widget's displayed data, filters, style, and interactions:
Configure the data displayed in the widget.
(Optional) Apply filters to the widget.
(Optional) Set the widget style.
(Optional) Configure the widget drill-down hierarchy.
(Optional) Enable Table View to display the data in a table format.
Click Save to save the widget to the dashboard.
To add more widgets, click Widget and repeat the process.
Click Save in the top right of the page to add the widget to the dashboard.
